note: roleassign_with_user_csv_import is a glue submodule of user_csv_import. Its only behaviour is hook_form_alter on the user_csv_import_form: it intersects the form's Roles checkbox #options with the assignable roles configured in RoleAssign (roleassign.settings -> roleassign_roles). It has no config, permissions, schema, services or Drush of its own. All medium/hard cases are therefore grounded in the roleassign.settings.roleassign_roles config object (a simple config write) that drives the integration; the import form's rendered role list is derived from it. The site's existing roles are anonymous, authenticated, content_editor, administrator.

evals.prompt: What does the roleassign_with_user_csv_import module do, and which two modules does it connect?
evals.expected_output: It is a glue module between User CSV Import and RoleAssign. It alters the user_csv_import_form so its Roles checkboxes only show the roles the current user may assign per RoleAssign (intersecting the form options with roleassign.settings roleassign_roles), so the form's visuals match what RoleAssign will actually allow.

evals.prompt: Which configuration decides the roles shown on the User CSV Import form when roleassign_with_user_csv_import is enabled, and does this submodule add its own settings?
evals.expected_output: It reads RoleAssign's own configuration: roleassign.settings -> roleassign_roles (the list of assignable roles). The submodule has no settings of its own; if roleassign_roles is empty it does not filter the form.

evals.prompt: On this site, RoleAssign restricts which roles a delegated admin may assign, and this drives the User CSV Import form. Inspect the live configuration and state which role(s) the import form will offer.
evals.expected_output: roleassign.settings roleassign_roles = [content_editor], so the User CSV Import form's Roles checkboxes are filtered to just content_editor (plus the always-mandatory Authenticated). Read with `drush cget roleassign.settings roleassign_roles`.

evals.prompt: This site has RoleAssign configured with a set of assignable roles that the CSV import form respects. Inspect the live configuration and list every role that the import form will show as selectable.
evals.expected_output: roleassign.settings roleassign_roles = [content_editor, administrator]; the import form will offer content_editor and administrator (the submodule intersects the form's role options with this list).

evals.prompt: Configure this site so that, via RoleAssign, the ONLY role a delegated admin may assign (and therefore the only non-mandatory role the User CSV Import form offers) is content_editor. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set roleassign.settings roleassign_roles so content_editor is the only assignable role (e.g. via RoleAssign's settings form at /admin/config/people/roleassign, or the config API).

evals.prompt: Configure RoleAssign on this site so that delegated admins may assign both the content_editor and administrator roles - which is exactly what the User CSV Import form will then offer. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set roleassign.settings roleassign_roles to include both content_editor and administrator.
